title.zh: Anthropic 数学家称借助 Claude 证明黎曼猜想，斯坦福发布纯人类的竞争证明
title.en: Anthropic mathematician claims Claude-assisted proof of Riemann hypothesis; Stanford posts a rival all-human draft

summary.zh: Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 称借助 Claude 证明了黎曼猜想，并以 Lean 形式化；数小时后，Alessandro Masullo 的纯人类证明草稿（广义黎曼猜想）也被公开，Brian Conrad 称其目前看起来可行。两者均未经验证。
summary.en: Anthropic's Levent Alpöge says he proved the Riemann hypothesis with Claude, formalized in Lean. Hours later an all-human draft proof (of the generalized hypothesis) by Alessandro Masullo surfaced, which Brian Conrad says looks good so far. Neither is verified yet.

why.zh: 若成立，将是 AI 参与数学前沿的里程碑，也考验验证机制。
why.en: If it holds, it is a milestone for AI in frontier math and a test of verification.

sources.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
Hours after Anthropic claims a Claude proof of the Riemann hypothesis, Stanford releases an all-human competing draft
AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too
Quoting Levent Alpöge
Quoting Ravi Vakil
[AINews] Riemann Hypothesis proved...twice independently

title.zh: Signal 限制移动端截屏，防止系统级 AI Agent 读取私密聊天
title.en: Signal restricts mobile screenshots to stop OS-level AI agents reading private chats

summary.zh: Signal 在 Android 和 iOS 上限制截屏，称 Siri AI、Gemini Intelligence、Meta Muse 等读取屏幕内容的 Agent 是对隐私的“生存威胁”，但承认保护仍不完整。
summary.en: Signal is limiting screenshots on Android and iOS, calling screen-reading agents such as Siri AI, Gemini Intelligence and Meta Muse an “existential threat” to privacy, while admitting protection remains incomplete.

why.zh: 系统级 Agent 与端到端加密应用的冲突开始落地。
why.en: The clash between OS-level agents and E2E-encrypted apps is becoming concrete.

sources.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats
Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen

title.zh: Thinking Machines 发布开源循环模型 Inkling 2 Mini，笔记本可运行
title.en: Thinking Machines releases open looped model Inkling 2 Mini that runs on a laptop

summary.zh: Inkling 2 Mini 是开源循环 Transformer，24 层中的 12 层每个 token 重复运行三次，用内部推理代替额外输出文字，可在笔记本上运行。
summary.en: Inkling 2 Mini is an open looped transformer that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token, reasoning internally instead of generating extra text, and it runs on a laptop.

why.zh: 用更少输出词换取推理能力，提供了端侧推理的新路线。
why.en: Trading output tokens for internal reasoning is a new route for on-device models.

sources.title: New open model Inkling 2 Mini thinks in loops to solve problems with fewer words and still runs on a laptop

title.zh: OpenAI 加固防护，GPT-6.2 推理过程提取成功率从 54% 降至 0.2%
title.en: OpenAI hardens safeguards: reasoning-extraction success on GPT-6.2 drops from 54% to 0.2%

summary.zh: OpenAI 称在自适应红队测试中，针对 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 提取受保护推理内容的成功率由 54% 降至 0.2%，并公布对抗性蒸馏的分层防护思路。
summary.en: OpenAI says adaptive red-teaming success at extracting protected reasoning from GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol fell from 54% to 0.2%, and describes a layered approach to adversarial distillation.

why.zh: 模型能力被蒸馏的防护成为头部厂商的重点。
why.en: Defending against capability distillation is now a priority for top vendors.

sources.title: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
Combatting adversarial distillation

title.zh: 字节与高校发布 Axion 1.0：仅三阶段训练即比肩商用模型
title.en: ByteDance and universities release Axion 1.0, matching commercial models with three training phases

summary.zh: Axion 1.0 是一个 AI Agent，在基准上可与 OpenAI、Anthropic 的顶级商用模型竞争，作者认为收益来自精心筛选的数据而非更多训练阶段。
summary.en: Axion 1.0 is an AI agent that rivals top OpenAI and Anthropic models on benchmarks after just three training phases; the authors attribute the gains to carefully curated data rather than more phases.

why.zh: 暗示复杂的多阶段训练流程未必必要。
why.en: Suggests elaborate multi-stage training pipelines may not be necessary.

sources.title: Bytedance argues most AI training phases are unnecessary and backs it up with a competitive open model

title.zh: 研究者向 AI 供应链植入 200 万个“金丝雀”，发现严重隐私泄露
title.en: Researcher plants 2M canaries in the AI supply chain and finds serious privacy leaks

summary.zh: 用带唯一可追踪秘密的提示词测试表明，数据在 AI 供应链中并未保持私密。
summary.en: Tests with prompts carrying unique trackable secrets show data does not stay private across the AI supply chain.

why.zh: 企业向 AI 服务发送敏感数据的风险得到实证。
why.en: Gives empirical weight to the risk of sending sensitive data to AI services.

sources.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.

title.zh: METR 更新能力曲线：编码持续指数提升，需要判断力的任务相对较弱
title.en: METR updates its capability graph: coding keeps improving exponentially, judgment-heavy tasks lag

summary.zh: AI 评估机构 METR 的新报告显示部分 AI 能力仍沿指数轨迹提升，但模型在需要判断的任务上不如编码任务。
summary.en: A new METR report finds some AI capabilities still improving exponentially, but models are weaker at tasks that require judgment than at coding.

why.zh: 这是业内最常被引用的进展图之一的最新数据。
why.en: This is the latest data on one of the field's most-cited progress charts.

sources.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update

title.zh: 英伟达研究者：超长上下文窗口是死胡同
title.en: Nvidia researchers argue huge context windows are a dead end

summary.zh: 研究认为模型往往用不到完整上下文，周期性摘要加定向关键词搜索在测试中通常能达到全上下文的效果。
summary.en: They argue models often do not need their full context windows, and in tests periodic summaries plus targeted keyword search usually matched full-context results.

why.zh: 对长上下文成本与 Agent 记忆设计有直接参考价值。
why.en: Directly relevant to long-context cost and agent memory design.

sources.title: Nvidia researchers argue huge AI context windows are a dead end

title.zh: 谷歌改版搜索首页：去掉搜索按钮，加入 AI 聊天记录
title.en: Google redesigns its search homepage: no search button, AI chat history added

summary.zh: 谷歌新搜索页面进一步拉近 AI 工具入口，加入 AI 侧边栏并去掉搜索按钮。
summary.en: Google's new search page puts AI tools closer, adding an AI sidebar and dropping the search button.

why.zh: 影响数十亿用户的搜索入口正在向 AI 倾斜。
why.en: The entry point used by billions is tilting toward AI.

sources.title: Google rolls out new search homepage with AI chat history and no search button

title.zh: 报道称苹果可能在开发能操作 Mac 的自家 AI Agent
title.en: Apple reportedly developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac

summary.zh: TechCrunch 报道，苹果似乎在开发可与 Meta Muse、Claude、OpenAI 等竞争的设备端 Agent。
summary.en: TechCrunch reports Apple appears to be building agents that could compete with Meta Muse, Claude and OpenAI's.

why.zh: 平台方入局会改变第三方桌面 Agent 的竞争环境。
why.en: Platform-owner entry would change the field for third-party desktop agents.

sources.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac
